The Bewilderment.name: The Bewilderment
The Bewilderment.description:
The afflicted creature's mind is gripped by @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}, a creeping arcane confusion that does not relent.

  • As its mind unravels, the afflicted has Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability checks.

  • The curse erodes body and spirit alike, leaving the afflicted Vulnerable to Necrotic damage.

Blessing of Abyss.name: Blessing of Abyss
Blessing of Abyss.description: You are blessed by the power of Abyss. While this blessing endures, your attunement to Abyss is heightened, granting +5 attunement points toward your effective rank, which may temporarily elevate your Abyss attunement to a higher rank.

Kaleidoscopic Confusion.name: Kaleidoscopic Confusion
Kaleidoscopic Confusion.description:
You are befuddled, your thoughts clouded, and words jumbled. You have trouble speaking coherently, and can't cast spells that have verbal components. You also have disadvantage on skill checks that require mental acuity or focus.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a long rest. It can be removed early by casting Dispel Magic or Lesser Restoration on the affected character.

Kaleidoscopic Fatigue.name: Kaleidoscopic Fatigue
Kaleidoscopic Fatigue.description:
The light from the crystal saps all of your energy. You suffer the effects of having 2 levels of &reference[exhaustion]. This exhaustion is unnatural and will not kill a character if they hit maximum exhaustion. Instead, it renders them &reference[unconscious] until the duration passes.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a long rest. It can be removed early by casting Dispel Magic or Lesser Restoration on the affected character.

Kaleidoscopic Focus.name: Kaleidoscopic Focus
Kaleidoscopic Focus.description:
Your mind becomes sharp and resilient against distractions. You gain resistance to Psychic damage if you don't already have it.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a long rest. It can be removed early by casting Dispel Magic or Lesser Restoration on the affected character.

Kaleidoscopic Glare.name: Kaleidoscopic Glare
Kaleidoscopic Glare.description:
All light becomes painful and overwhelming for your eyes. You suffer disadvantage on any actions taken while in bright light.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a long rest. It can be removed early by casting Dispel Magic or Lesser Restoration on the affected character.

Kaleidoscopic Haunting.name: Kaleidoscopic Haunting
Kaleidoscopic Haunting.description:
You hear whispers and glimpse ominous shapes in the shadows around you. You cannot enter dim light or darkness without a successful [[/save cha 12]] saving throw first.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a long rest. It can be removed early by casting Dispel Magic or Lesser Restoration on the affected character.

Kaleidoscopic Intoxication.name: Kaleidoscopic Intoxication
Kaleidoscopic Intoxication.description:
You feel unsteady on your feet, your limbs are sluggish, and your mind is dulled. You suffer the effects of the &reference[poisoned] condition. Resistance or immunity to poison cannot prevent this.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a long rest. It can be removed early by casting Dispel Magic or Lesser Restoration on the affected character.

Luminous Crystallization.name: Luminous Crystallization
Luminous Crystallization.description:
The afflicted creature's flesh is slowly transmuted into a luminous, crystalline substance by the touch of an Uncanny Relic. The transformation is painful and spreading, hardening the limbs and creeping inexorably toward the core.

  • Crystalline rigidity reduces the afflicted creature's Speed by 10 feet.

  • The brittle crystal is easily shattered and corroded: the afflicted is Vulnerable to Bludgeoning and Acid damage.

  • Conversely, the luminous crystal drinks in light, granting Resistance to Radiant damage.

Ward of Stabilization.name: Ward of Stabilization
Ward of Stabilization.description: This protective ward calls upon the earth below to provide resistance to Acid damage by causing the elements needed to neutralize the corrosive liquid to spontaneously manifest when the warded individual is struck.

Ward of Thunder.name: Ward of Thunder
Ward of Thunder.description: This retributive ward calls upon the sky above to deal [[/damage 1d6 thunder]] damage to anyone who hits the warded character with a melee attack as a booming thunder clap resounds back at the attacker.
